classification.difficultyReason: Find the base diagonal exactly, then use tangent to find the angle of a space diagonal.

content.prompt: Consider the rectangular prism. Calculate the angle $\angle FAE$ to the nearest degree.

spec.description: Unfilled prism with ordinary edges in black and the two diagonals defining angle FAE highlighted in house blue.
spec.mathematics: Front face ABCD; rear face HEFG; connecting edges AH, BE, CF and DG. AB=12 cm, AH=8 cm, HG=6 cm. Faces ABCD, HEFG, ABEH, BCFE, DCFG and ADGH. Front, left and top faces are visible; HE, EF and EB are hidden. AE and AF are separately retained construction diagonals.

answer.worked:
In right-angled triangle $AHE$,
$$\begin{aligned}AE^2&=8^2+12^2\\AE^2&=208\\AE&=\sqrt{208}\ \mathrm{cm}.\end{aligned}$$
In right-angled triangle $AEF$, $EF=6\ \mathrm{cm}$.
$$\begin{aligned}\tan\angle FAE&=\frac{6}{\sqrt{208}}\\\angle FAE&=\tan^{-1}\left(\frac{6}{\sqrt{208}}\right)\\\angle FAE&\approx23^\circ.\end{aligned}$$
